fonts.install_command: Import Tajawal and Cairo from Google Fonts in the main CSS file.

rules.hierarchy: Headings must be tracking-tight. Body text needs slightly larger sizes due to Arabic glyph dimensions.
rules.alignment: text-right by default due to RTL.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8) for breathing room within containers.

dashboard_rules.top_row: KPI Summary Cards (Total Sales, Orders, Profit). Use col-span-1.
dashboard_rules.second_row: Charts and Breakdowns. Main Chart col-span-2, Feed/List col-span-1.
dashboard_rules.alignment: Optical alignment prioritizing RTL scanning logic.

rtl_specifics.sidebar: Placed on the RIGHT side of the screen.
rtl_specifics.margins: Use ms- and me- instead of ml- and mr- (margin-start, margin-end) or explicit ms-/me- utilities.
rtl_specifics.padding: Use ps- and pe- instead of pl- and pr-.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), rounded-xl. No heavy shadows. On hover: slight lift, shadow-sm.
components.buttons: rounded-lg. Primary buttons use #0A3622 background. Ensure text color changes on hover.
components.charts: Recharts. Use Line charts for trends, Horizontal Bar charts for shipping/payment breakdowns. Tooltips must support RTL.
components.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized. Ensure text-right for input fields and right-aligned icons.

auth_background.description: Use as the background image for the split-screen login/register page. Add a bg-black/30 overlay to ensure text contrast if putting text over it.

empty_state_upload.description: Use this on the 'Upload Excel' drag-and-drop area when no file is selected. Max-width 150px.

app_logo.description: Use as the main application logo in the Sidebar and Navbar.

user_placeholder.description: Use for the user profile avatar or dropdown toggle.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the HTML document has dir='rtl' and lang='ar'. Verify Shadcn components behave correctly in RTL.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-excel-btn').
Do NOT use glassmorphism. This is a secure financial app, use solid surfaces.
Use Recharts for all visual data. Tooltips must render RTL correctly.
Do not use Inter font. Strictly use Tajawal for headings and Cairo for body.
Use Tailwind logical properties like padding-inline-start (ps-) instead of pl- to ensure RTL compatibility.
Write all frontend layout in .jsx/.js as the system does not support .tsx.
